rationale: diff_patch creates/applies textual unified diffs and patches (diff.create, patch.apply, three-way merge); git exposes diff as one sub-operation of version control (git.diff(ref)). The bare 'diff' is ambiguous. Delegate: diff_patch keeps 'diff' (the generic diff/patch concept); git receives the more specific 'git diff' trigger so it is only matched when the user clearly wants a VCS diff.
actions_taken: Removed bare trigger 'diff' from git in ROUTE_REGISTRY.json
Removed trigger entry {pattern:'diff', skill:'git'} from TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
Added trigger 'git diff' -> git (functional, 0.8) to TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
